title: Settlement Run
tagline: On foot in an Odyssey settlement: download every data port while security hunts the corridors.
description: A maze of corridors round a settlement's security office, full of data ports to download. Four guards patrol it, each in its own way: the Sentry chases, the Hunter heads you off, the Warden flanks and the Officer keeps its distance. Grab an Energy Link and their suits overload for a while: catch them then for points, and they limp back to the office to reboot. The airlock tunnel wraps round. Empty the settlement to move on.
